About connections and preview

Use a value or select a compatible output from another component. Inputs marked ⚡ can also receive events with their captured payload. Turn off Receive events to use the current value with a separate trigger. Matching names include instance numbers and position hints. Preview does not advance timers or deliver triggers or events. Save applies your changes; Cancel keeps the original.

Library categories

Categories are tags. A shape can belong to several. Renaming or removing a tag updates its memberships, not the shapes.

    Print sketch

    Preparing snapshot…

    Pages run left to right, then top to bottom. Trim the margins and join neighbouring sheets. Overlap and matching alignment marks help you line them up. All sheets print at 100%.

    In the browser print dialog, use the same paper and orientation, 100% / Actual size, no additional margins, and headers and footers off. The preview already includes your margins and any Fit to page scaling.
